audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side rows say 'Skill' while content win[0-5] say 'Hwei' and win[6] says 'Milio' — every row of the level chart disagrees between the two layers.
audit.why: The content-layer whys[] are already specific and grounded (EQ outranging Milio's melee Q, W-ult plus EE outdamaging a single Breath of Life, then Milio's 2-item R cleanse/shield/range steroid flipping it) — that's the correct verdict per row; the full layer was left on a flat template.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0-5].side to 'Hwei' and phases[6].side to 'Milio', rewriting each why to match the content-layer reasoning for that row.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text labels Hwei's ultimate 'Spiraling Despair' as '(W ult zone)' when it is his R — the ownerKit confirms the ultimate (the despair painting) is the R slot, and phases[4].label 'Level 6' already treats it as the ult spike.
audit.why: ownerKit.abilities R text describes 'a vision of pure despair' — the ultimate. Labeling it W is a slot mislabel that could confuse a reader mid-combo.
audit.corrected: Change '(W ult zone)' to '(R)' in spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real cooldown number (lint flag), and the missing-interaction on Milio's sustain (Cozy Campfire (W) heal zone, Breath of Life (R) heal) is never named with real numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: enemyKit gives Milio W cd 29/27/25/23/21 and R cd 160/145/130 — both real cooldowns that make the anti-heal-timing advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Rewrite breakdown.cooldowns with Milio's real R and W cooldowns, and ground breakdown.trading in the sustain/anti-heal interaction instead of the generic paint-mark template.
